summary: Preserve Node util.format placeholder, coercion, inspection, and extra-argument behavior.

requirements.arguments: runtime values represented by JS-compatible value layer

target.notes: The helper may delegate object rendering to the NodeUtil.Inspect runtime contract.

semantics.specifiers: supports Node format specifiers and %% escaping
semantics.non_format_first_argument: arguments are converted/formatted according to Node util.format rules

caveats: String.Format interpolation syntax and numeric formatting do not match Node.
Circular objects and inspection options require Node inspect behavior.
